Elden Ring is an action role-playing game developed by FromSoftware and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment, released on February 25, 2022 for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. Directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki with worldbuilding provided by George R.R. Martin, the game is set in the Lands Between where players control a customizable character on a quest to repair the Elden Ring and become the new Elden Lord.

The game features an open world that can be traversed using a steed named Torrent, with linear hidden dungeons for exploring to find useful items. Players engage enemies using various weapons and magic spells and can focus on non-direct engagement enabled by stealth mechanics. The game's world contains checkpoints that enable fast travel and allow players to improve their attributes using an in-game currency called runes.

Elden Ring features an online multiplayer mode, allowing players to join for cooperative play to fight bosses or engage in player versus player combat. FromSoftware aimed to create an open-world game based on Dark Souls, with Martin contributing to the backstory and Miyazaki acting as lead writer for the in-game narrative.

Elden Ring received several Game of the Year awards and has been cited as one of the greatest games of all time. It sold over 30 million copies, making it one of the best-selling games of all time. The downloadable content (DLC) Shadow of the Erdtree was released in June 2024 to similar acclaim and sold over ten million copies. A multiplayer-focused spinoff game, Elden Ring Nightreign, was released in 2025.

You can purchase Elden Ring on Steam for PC or console versions like PlayStation 5, PS4, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. The standalone adventure, Elden Ring Nightreign, is also available on Steam.

Based on your preferences and the current market, I would highly recommend "Death Stranding Director's Cut" for PlayStation 5. It's an action role-playing game developed by Kojima Productions that features photo-realistic graphics and online multiplayer elements. The Director's Cut version includes additional content not found in the original release.

As of now, you can purchase it digitally on the PlayStation Store for approximately $59.99 USD (prices may vary depending on region). This game fits your criteria while staying below the 90 USD price point you specified. Enjoy exploring the unique post-apocalyptic world in Death Stranding!

In case you're interested in other games from my earlier recommendations, "Stray" and "Halo Infinite" are also action-packed titles with great graphics that you might enjoy. However, they don't meet all your preferences as neither of them is an RPG or has online multiplayer elements in their core gameplay.

For more RPG options with online multiplayer features, I recommend checking out "Tower of Fantasy," a free-to-play MMORPG with vibrant graphics and action-based combat. Another recommendation would be "Blade & Soul," a stylized Korean MMORPG inspired by martial arts and Asian mythology, which can be played for free as well.

Based on my knowledge base and the latest search results, I'd like to recommend some popular and well-received games developed in Indonesia for you to try out:

1. A Space for the Unbound - Developed by Mojiken Studio from Surabaya, this game offers a captivating narrative adventure that takes players on a journey through the lives of two high school students. You can find it on various platforms like Steam, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch.

2. DreadOut - This horror game by Digital Happiness is set in an Indonesian university campus haunted by supernatural entities. It's available on Steam for PC.

3. Selera Nusantara - Developed by Gambir Game Studio, this cooking simulation game allows players to prepare various Indonesian dishes while exploring the culture and traditions of Indonesia. You can download it from Google Play Store on your mobile device.

4. Lokapala - Created by Cipayung Digital, Lokapala is an action RPG where you play as a hero defending Indonesia against mythical creatures and threats. It's available on the App Store and Google Play Store for mobile devices.

5. Coffee Talk - Developed by Toge Productions from Jakarta, Coffee Talk is a narrative-driven game set in a coffee shop where players interact with various characters, exploring themes of friendship, mental health, and personal growth. It's available on Steam, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, iOS, and Android.

I hope you find these recommendations enjoyable! Happy gaming!
